description:
This protocol updates an existing protocol request from Opentrons API Version 1 to Opentrons API Version 2.

Using the customizable parameters below, you can specify which column to start picking up tips from and how many samples are in each run for each protocol. 

This protocol uses custom labware definitions for the glass trough (Electron Microscopy Sciences), Omegaquant 96-Well Plate, Blood Tube Rack, and 200ul Tip Rack. When downloading the protocol, the labware definitions (a JSON file) will be included for use with this protocol. For more information on using custom labware on the OT-2, please see this article: Using labware in your protocols


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)
Opentrons P50 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat
Opentrons 96 Tip Rack 300 µL
Opentrons 300µL Tips
Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish [https://www.emsdiasum.com/microscopy/products/histology/staining.aspx#70314]
Reagents



Slot 2: Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat
Slot 4: Opentrons 96 Tip-Rack 300ul
Slot 5: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish
Slot 9: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish
P300-Multi Mount: Left


Using the customizations field (below), set up your protocol.
 Number of Samples: Specify number of samples in well plate.
 Starting Tip Column: Specify which column of tips to begin drawing from.

labware.name: Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat on 2
Electron Microscopy Sciences 1 Reservoir 100000 µL on 5
Electron Microscopy Sciences 1 Reservoir 100000 µL on 9
